entry_sequence.action: Identify the opening range (OR) using the first three candles after the 9:30 AM NY market open on the 15-minute chart.
entry_sequence.rationale: The OR defines the initial high and low for the day.

entry_sequence.action: Wait for a candle to break out and close outside of the defined opening range.
entry_sequence.rationale: The close outside the range confirms the breakout direction.

entry_sequence.action: Enter at the open of the candle immediately following the breakout candle.
entry_sequence.rationale: Entry is taken immediately after the breakout confirmation.

stop.rationale: The stop loss goes at the bottom of the opening range.

targets.rationale: Target 1.5 to one reward to risk.

After that, I'm just waiting for a candle to break out through this range... So, in this case, my signal is this candle here because it's the first one to actually break out and then close outside of that range.
But often what seems to happen after the initial breakout is that we get this pullback towards the opening range. This is how the modified strategy will work.
